changes.summary: Default animation keys renamed on `defaultAnimations` object
changes.details: interactive→element, overlay→layer, overlayBackdrop→layerBackdrop, expandable→content, menu→popup, menuItem→popupItem, toggleable→indicator
changes.migration: Update references: `defaultAnimations.interactive` → `defaultAnimations.element`, etc. The old type aliases (InteractiveAnimate, etc.) are kept as deprecated re-exports.

changes.summary: Removed `itemIndicator` and `itemText` slots from Select.Item
changes.details: Select.Item no longer renders indicator/text wrappers. Selected item is now highlighted via CSS `[data-selected]`.
changes.migration: Remove any `pt` targeting `itemIndicator` or `itemText`. Use `pt={{ item: ... }}` instead.

changes.summary: CSS custom properties renamed from `--move-input-*` to `--move-password-*`
changes.details: All component tokens on Password now use the `--move-password-` prefix instead of sharing `--move-input-` with InputText.
changes.migration: Find/replace `--move-input-` → `--move-password-` in any Password-specific CSS overrides.

changes.summary: Content no longer applies padding directly; uses flex column layout
changes.details: Content changed from `overflow:auto` + padding to `overflow:hidden` + `display:flex; flex-direction:column`. Padding now lives in new Header/Body/Footer sub-components. Close button is no longer `position:absolute`.
changes.migration: Use `Dialog.Header`, `Dialog.Body`, and `Dialog.Footer` to structure content. Remove custom padding on Dialog.Content.

changes.summary: Removed `--move-tooltip-transition-duration` CSS custom property
changes.details: Entrance animation is now handled by anime.js spring; exit uses a hardcoded 120ms CSS animation.
changes.migration: Remove any overrides of `--move-tooltip-transition-duration`. Use the `animate` prop on Tooltip.Content to customise.

changes.summary: Removed `--move-checkbox-hit-area` CSS custom property
Animation type aliases deprecated in favour of new names
changes.details: InteractiveAnimate→ElementAnimate, ExpandableAnimate→ContentAnimate, ToggleableAnimate→IndicatorAnimate, OverlayAnimate→LayerAnimate, MenuAnimate→PopupAnimate, MenuItemAnimate→PopupItemAnimate
changes.migration: Update imports to new names. Old aliases still work but will be removed in a future version.

changes.summary: Tooltip can now be used as a simple wrapper: `<Tooltip label="...">...</Tooltip>`
New `animate` prop on Tooltip.Content
New `size` prop on Dialog.Content and new Header/Body/Footer/FooterStart/FooterEnd sub-components
New `size` and `invalid` props
New `size`, `invalid`, and horizontal orientation support
New `invalid` and `label` props
New `animate` prop on Root, `invalid`/`width` on Trigger, `label` on Item
New `animate` prop on Dropdown.Root
New `pt` prop on Tabs.Root, new `animate` prop on Tabs.List
Built-in fallback icons work without IconProvider; new `useResolvedIcon` hook exported
Root element now sets default font-family, font-size, and color from tokens
New semantic tokens: scrollbar, overlay variants (`--move-overlay-light`, `--move-overlay-heavy`, `--move-overlay-blur`)
Theme token values now use `var()` references to palette instead of hardcoded hex
New layout component tokens (`--move-button-height`, `--move-button-radius`, etc.) allow external override
Focus style changed from box-shadow to outline for consistency
Focus ring no longer flashes during `:active`; mouse clicks no longer show outline
On-state styles now correctly override all Button variant rules via higher specificity
